title: Story (example rubric: copy to rubrics/<stage>.json and edit)
judge_notes: A 15-30 s ad story for a small business. Judge the chosen direction only.

questions.text: Does the chosen story open with a hook a viewer understands with the sound off in the first 3 seconds?
Is every claim about the product found in research.md?
questions.evidence: Quote each claim and the research line it comes from.

questions.text: Does the story end on the brief's call to action?
questions.evidence: Quote the last beat and the brief's call to action.

questions.text: Is the story between 40 and 160 words?
Does story.md have the sections Directions, Chosen and Beats?
